// NEGATIVE fixture — `??` only where a lexer must not see it. The gate must report nothing.
// A line comment: value ?? fallback
/* A block comment: value ?? fallback */
const SINGLE = 'value ?? fallback';
const DOUBLE = "value ?? fallback";
const TEMPLATE = `call orDefault(value, fallback), never value ?? fallback`;
const IN_REGEX = /\?\?/;

export function mentionsNullish(source) {
  // Regex in expression position after `return`.
  return /\?\?/.test(source);
}

export function withDefault(value, fallback) {
  return value === null || value === undefined ? fallback : value;
}

export { SINGLE, DOUBLE, TEMPLATE, IN_REGEX };
